jobs.title: Operations Supervisor
jobs.description:
We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

**Position Summary**  

An Operations Supervisor is a key leader supporting the CVS Store Management team in planning and driving store execution and performance while building consumer loyalty to CVS/pharmacy through a focus on excellent customer service. When there is no manager onsite, the Operations Supervisor leads the store and supervisory staff, ensures that store operations run smoothly, and is responsible for ensuring the completion of all opening and closing procedures.


Essential Functions:


1\. Management

* Work effectively with store management and store crews

* Supervise the store’s crew through assigning, directing and following up of all


activities

* Effectively communicate information both to and from store management and crews


2\. Customer Service

* Assist customers with their questions, problems and complaints




* Promote CVS customer service culture. (Greet, offer help, and thank)

* Handle all customer relations issues in accordance with company policy

and promote a positive shopping experience for all CVS customers


Provide colleagues personalized customer service feedback and coaching (E.g., myImpact coaching; myCustomer feedback; personal observations)

* Maintain customer/patient confidentiality


3\. Merchandise/Presentation

* Price merchandise

* Stock shelves

* Support the planning, execute the displays, sign and inventory of weekly,

promotional, and seasonal merchandise

* Support the planning, execute the display and maintenance of off\-shelf merchandise

 **Required Qualifications**  

* Deductive reasoning ability, analytical skills and computer skills.
* Advanced communication skills, supervision, and influencing skills
* Ability to work a full\-time flexible schedule, including some early morning, overnight and weekend shifts, to work overtime as needed, and to respond to urgent issues at the store when they arise

  

**Preferred Qualifications*** Experience as a retail supervisor

 **Education**
High School diploma or equivalent preferred but not required.

**Anticipated Weekly Hours**


30**Time Type**


Full time**Pay Range**


The typical pay range for this role is:


$21\.61 \- $30\.61
This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full\-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors.

  

Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong.

**Great benefits for great people**


We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families.

  

This full‑time position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues and their families. The benefits for this position include medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, retirement savings options, wellness programs, and other resources, based on eligibility.  

Additional details about available benefits are provided during the application process and on Benefits Moments.

  

We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on: 11/25/2026
Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state and local laws.

jobs.description:
Are you looking for a meaningful role in behavioral health and have the desire to work with an organization that puts people first? If you have a passion for helping others along their recovery journey, then we invite you to join our Crestwood family!


**For more than 50\+ years** Crestwood has been committed to creating innovative recovery programs and developing compassionate communities that support each client in their journey. Our model of care focuses on a personal and self\-directed process that empowers the people we serve and helps them to develop the skills to thrive!

**Title:** Service Coordinator (Mental Health Case Manager)


**Job Duties:** The Service Coordinator (Mental Health Case Manager) assesses clients to identify individual problem areas necessitating treatment and complete assessments. The Service Coordinator (Mental Health Case Manager) also coordinates the interdisciplinary team meetings and discharge planning efforts among the multidisciplinary treatment team. In this capacity, the Service Coordinator (Mental Health Case Manager) coordinates the overall treatment plan implementation for the client on the unit, working closely with the nursing staff to ensure continuity of treatment efforts.


**Schedule:**


* Full\-Time: PM (Tues\-Sat)
* Full\-Time: PM (Sun\-Thurs)


**Qualifications:**


* Two (2\) years of full\-time experience or part\-time equivalent in a mental health setting.
* A bachelor's degree with a major in psychology, social work or behavioral sciences may be substituted for the two (2\) years of full\-time work experience or its part\-time equivalent.
* Demonstrated knowledge of DSM\-5 and psychosocial rehabilitation and recovery principles.
* Familiarity with regulatory standards.


**Crestwood Offers Comprehensive Benefits Packages to Full\-Time Employees Including:**


* Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
* Life Insurance
* Vacation
* Paid Sick Leave
* Sick Leave Buy Back
* 401(k) Retirement
* Scholarship Program
* Qualifying Supervision for BBS Associates
* Competitive Pay
* Paid Holidays

**About the Campus:** Our services at the San Francisco Healing Center support each client to recover with an enhanced sense of resilience, accessing a wide range of wellness tools and staff support. jobs.title: Manager, Customer Success
jobs.description:
Our Customer Success team is committed to helping customers maximize the value of Asana as both a technology platform and a holistic approach to collaboration. From high touch to scalable success, our goal is to deepen the usage of the whole work graph, resulting in delivering unmatched value with scalability and consistency. We strive to help all of our customers, across countries, industries, and functions, get off on the right foot and continue to get the most value out of Asana over time.



As a Manager, Customer Success (L7\), you will lead our Enterprise Accounts team, taking ownership of the health, growth, and strategic value delivery of our most critical enterprise customer relationships. Reporting to Customer Success leadership, you will coach and develop a team of Enterprise Customer Success Managers, build scalable programs that drive adoption and AI consumption, and serve as a key cross\-functional partner across Sales, Product, and Enablement. You will bring people leadership, operational excellence, and customer obsession to drive AI\-driven transformation across our enterprise portfolio.



This role is based in our San Francisco office with an office\-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in\-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in\-office requirements.


### **What you'll achieve**


* **People Leadership \& Coaching:** Coach, mentor, and develop a high\-performing team of Enterprise CSMs through regular 1:1s, performance reviews, and career development planning while defining goals, KPIs, and success metrics.
* **Executive Relationship Advisory:** Build and nurture executive\-level relationships with enterprise customers, serving as an escalation point, strategic advisor, and leader for executive business reviews.
* **Program \& Operational Scaling:** Design and launch scalable programs and operational frameworks to improve customer health, drive product adoption and AI consumption, and optimize retention across the enterprise portfolio.
* **Portfolio Risk \& Opportunity Management:** Identify, track, and mitigate churn risk while systematically surfacing and converting expansion opportunities.
* **Cross\-Functional Voice of Customer:** Partner closely with Sales on account strategy and collaborate with Product to capture product gaps, synthesize customer feedback, and influence the product roadmap.

### **About you**


* **Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision\-making.**
* 7\+ years of experience in Customer Success or Account Management within Enterprise SaaS, with at least 2–3 years in a direct people leadership or team management role.
* Proven track record managing complex, high\-value enterprise accounts, with experience in the AI or ML space strongly preferred.
* Operationally minded leader capable of building, executing, and iterating on programs, playbooks, and processes at scale.
* Commanding executive presence with comfort navigating C\-suite relationships on behalf of your team and the organization.
* Strong analytical mindset with experience owning and reporting against key SaaS metrics, including GRR, NRR, and adoption KPIs.
* Exceptional cross\-functional communicator skilled at partnering across Sales, Product, and Enablement teams.


At Asana, we're committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you're interested in this role and don't meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.


### **What we'll offer**



Our comprehensive compensation package plays a big part in how we recognize you for the impact you have on our path to achieving our mission. We believe that compensation should be reflective of the value you create relative to the market value of your role. To ensure pay is fair and not impacted by biases, we're committed to looking at market value which is why we check ourselves and conduct a yearly pay equity audit.



For this role, the estimated base salary range is between $238,000\-280,000\. The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process. The listed range above is a guideline, and the base salary range for this role may be modified.



In addition to base salary, your compensation package may include additional components such as equity, sales incentive pay (for most sales roles), and benefits. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your recruiter to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.



We strive to provide equitable and competitive benefits packages that support our employees worldwide and include:


* Mental health, wellness \& fitness benefits
* Career coaching \& support
* Inclusive family building benefits
* Long\-term savings or retirement plans
* In\-office culinary options to cater to your dietary preferences


These are just some of the benefits we offer, and benefits may vary based on role, country, and local regulations. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your Talent Acquisition Partner to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.

**About us**



Asana is a leading platform for human \+ AI collaboration. Millions of teams around the world rely on Asana to achieve their most important goals, faster. jobs.title: Manager, Service Delivery
jobs.description:
**Job Title**
=============


Manager, Service Delivery**Job Description Summary**
===========================


The Manager of Service Delivery is responsible for overseeing day to day operations across assigned facilities or campus environments, ensuring all services—including custodial, engineering, life\-safety, site services, and general maintenance—are delivered in alignment with C\&W Services standards and client expectations. This role provides leadership in facilities operations, staff management, vendor oversight, financial stewardship, and continuous service improvement.  

  

The Manager ensures all maintenance and janitorial programs are executed effectively, responds promptly to tenant and occupant needs, and maintains a comprehensive set of site\-specific documentation and compliance records. This position manages contracts, reviews budgets, leads annual planning processes, and contributes to long term capital and improvement strategies. The Manager also collects and analyzes operational data to evaluate service delivery performance and identify cost reduction opportunities.  

  

Serving as the primary liaison between clients, vendors, and internal teams, the Manager of Service Delivery builds strong relationships, enforces compliance with safety and insurance requirements, and upholds all terms of the management agreement.
  

  

The role includes hiring, training, and motivating facility personnel while fostering a collaborative, high performing team culture. With strong technical proficiency, financial acumen, and leadership capability, the Manager ensures facilities are maintained to high standards and that service outcomes consistently meet defined Service Level Agreements.**Job Description**
===================

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES**  

* Ensure the day\-to\-day operations of the facility(ies) or campus, including custodial, life\-safety, engineering, site services, and general maintenance, are implemented and carried out in a manner consistent with C\&W policies and client directives
* Manage all contracts to ensure they are reviewed on a regular basis and are bid out as required; verify that invoices match contract pricing
* Supervise all maintenance programs relating to the interior and exterior conditions and appearance of the properties
* Respond positively and promptly to requests from building tenants and occupants. Oversee the implementation of ongoing contract programs to constantly assess tenant and occupant needs and to ensure problems are being solved promptly to the mutual benefit of the tenant, client, and the properties in accordance with contract scope and Service Level Agreements (SLA’s)
* Ensure that all site\-specific documentation and reports are completed accurately and on time, including (and as applicable): Property Information Book, Site Operating Manual, Emergency Procedures Manual, IIPP Manual, Local Code Compliance Log, ADA Compliance Log, OSHA Log, Safety Meeting Log, Elevator Logs, Janitorial Log, Purchase Order Log, Vendor Certificates of Insurance, As\-built Drawings, IIPP Manual, Paid Invoices File, General Files, Contract Files, Annual Property Conditions and Year\-end Performance Report, and other reports and documentation, as required
* Prepare, review, and give initial approval and as needed all budgets, financial reports (monthly and quarterly), contracts, expenditures and purchase orders related to the facility(ies) or complex.
* Coordinate the preparation and publication of the annual budget, quarterly reforecast, and business plans
* Assist in the development of capital budgets for the property. This includes contributions towards a five\-year plan of maintenance, facility improvement, and cost reduction initiatives
* Collect, analyze and report statistical data as may be required to provide accurate and current assessment of facility management objectives
* Hire, train and motivate facility personnel. Maintain positive staff relations. Conduct or approve performance evaluations for staff
* Thoroughly familiar with the management contract and all requirements contained therein
* Monitor and ensure that tenants and vendors comply with insurance requirements and coordinate all claims, as required
**KEY COMPETENCIES**  

1\. Communication Proficiency (oral and written)  

2\. Technical Proficiency  

3\. Problem Solving/Analysis  

4\. Leadership  

5\. Teamwork Orientation  

6\. Relationship Management  

7\. Financial Management

 **IMPORTANT EDUCATION**  

* Bachelors degree in Facilities Management, Corporate Real Estate, Project Management, or Business Administration required
 **IMPORTANT EXPERIENCE**  

* A minimum of 5\-7 years of commercial high\-rise, campus environment, and/or property portfolio management experience required
* Experience in leasing, construction, engineering and all facets of property operation and building management preferred
* Experience with critical system environments desired
* Experience in the development and implementation of programs to drive out cost inefficiencies preferred
* CMMS/Work Order Management experience preferred
 **ADDITIONAL ELIGIBILITY QUALIFICATIONS**  

* Certified Facility Manager (CFM), International Facilities Management Association (IFMA), Building Owners and Managers Association (BOMA) industry certifications recommended; other Engineering, Business or technical training or certifications preferred
* Ability to read and understand construction specifications and blueprints
* Proficient in understanding management agreements and contract language
* Excellent computer and systems knowledge: Strong literacy in Microsoft Office Suite (MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint)
* Strong discipline of financial management including financial tracking, budgeting and forecasting
* Knowledge of Financial Systems (Yardi a plus)
* Skilled in Building Management Systems maintenance and monitoring

jobs.title: CCAC Regional Supervisor - Operations & Onboarding Support
jobs.description:
**Job Description:**


Location: Remote (California\-based required). Preference for Sacramento, Fresno, and Stockton areas  

Reports to: Program Manager, California Climate Action Corps  

Status: Full\-Time, Exempt  

Salary: $83,300–$89,100 annually (DOE)  

Start Date: Open until filled

  

Benefits:

* 3\+ weeks vacation
* 14 paid holidays \+ additional sick leave
* Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and mental health coverage
* 403(b) retirement plan
* Annual career development funds
* Remote position, but occasional travel throughout California expected

**About California Climate Action Corps (CCAC)**
------------------------------------------------


California Climate Action Corps (CCAC), a state service program led by California Volunteers, Office of the Governor, and implemented by Bay Area Community Resources (BACR), mobilizes emerging leaders to take direct climate action in communities across California. With over 400 fellows and 100\+ host partners, CCAC supports impactful service projects focused on urban greening, organic waste and edible food recovery, wildfire resiliency, and climate education and volunteer engagement. The program is rooted in service, equity, and sustainability.

### **Position Summary**


The Regional Supervisor – Operations \& Onboarding is a dynamic, multifaceted role responsible for both regional fellowship support and critical program operations for the California Climate Action Corps (CCAC). Approximately half of the role focuses on serving as a Regional Supervisor for a cohort of Fellows and Host Partners, while the other half focuses on owning key administrative, financial, compliance, and operational processes that support a 400\+ Fellow, 100\+ Host Partner Fellowship.


As a Regional Supervisor, this position serves as a primary program liaison across multiple Host Partner sites, providing ongoing support to Fellows and their Site Supervisors, conducting monthly virtual check\-ins and bi\-annual in\-person visits, supporting professional development, and helping ensure a successful Fellowship experience. On the operations side, this position will own high\-volume, detail\-oriented processes including timecard administration, reimbursements, financial reporting, and offer support for onboarding and offboarding, compliance tracking, and audits.

  

This role requires someone who can zoom in on the details while keeping the big picture in view. The ideal candidate is a proactive and organized self\-starter who takes ownership of complex processes, effectively manages competing priorities, and thrives in a fast\-paced, evolving environment.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Operations \& Finance**

* Own and manage the fellowship timecard approval process and reporting for 400\+ fellows, including reviewing, tracking, and resolving timecard issues
* Manage fellowship reimbursements, review documentation for accuracy and compliance, and coordinate timely processing
* Organize, prepare, and submit financial reports, ensuring information is accurate, complete, and submitted by required deadlines
* Coordinate key onboarding and offboarding processes for 400\+ fellows annually
* Identify opportunities to improve administrative systems and processes, taking initiative to create greater consistency, efficiency, and accountability
* Support program audits by maintaining organized records, gathering documentation, and responding to requests

### **Fellow Regional Supervision**

* Support the professional development of each AmeriCorps Fellow
* Help facilitate and plan member development training days, community building, and celebrations
* Act as Regional Supervisor for fellows and host partners, meeting virtually on a monthly basis and occasionally conducting in\-person site visits
* Collect all member evaluation and metrics reporting documentation
* Oversee and approve AmeriCorps timesheets, track AmeriCorps hours, and support fellow professional development and post\-fellowship transition

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree and 3\+ years of experience in one or more of the following:
	+ Program or operations administration
	+ Finance, financial administration, or grant administration
	+ Compliance, reporting, or audit support
	+ Onboarding or human resources support
	+ Stakeholder or partnership coordination
	+ Nonprofit, AmeriCorps, or other service\-oriented programs
* A highly organized, detail\-oriented self\-starter who can take ownership of complex processes from start to finish, manage high\-volume work and competing priorities, and maintain accuracy across multiple systems
* Strong problem\-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot issues, navigate challenging conversations, balance competing needs, and follow through
* Strong interpersonal and relationship\-building skills, with the ability to provide guidance and support to Fellows, Host Partners, and internal team members
* Adaptability and resilience in a fast\-moving environment, with the ability to adjust to changing program needs and priorities
* Strong remote\-work skills, including proactive communication, accountability, and responsiveness
* Experience with project management, reporting, Salesforce, Slack, Google Suite, or the ability to learn new systems quickly
* Experience with sustainability, environmental, or AmeriCorps programs, and familiarity with California environmental policy is a plus

**About Bay Area Community Resources**
--------------------------------------


Bay Area Community Resources (BACR) promotes the healthy development of individuals, families, and communities through direct services, volunteerism, and partnerships in California. Bay Area Community Resources is an equal\-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Visit our website at www.bacr.org.

jobs.title: Business Strategy and Operations Program Manager, Data Center Operations
jobs.description:
Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.  

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Sunnyvale, CA, USA; Atlanta, GA, USA; Council Bluffs, IA, USA; Midlothian, TX, USA; The Dalles, OR, USA; Leesburg, VA, USA; Lenoir, NC, USA; Sparks, NV, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in program or project management.
* 8 years of experience in business strategy, operations, or program management, with a focus on designing and driving organizational processes.
* 8 years of experience managing organizational rhythms (e.g., monthly/quarterly business reviews, OKR tracking, leadership summits) or executing internal communication strategies for operations.
* 8 years of experience managing cross\-functional programs.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 5 years of experience in business operations or operational program management in a data center environment.
* 5 years of experience establishing business\-centric metrics, KPIs, and evaluation frameworks for complex organizations.
* Experience with designing and implementing process improvements or change management initiatives that resulted in measurable organizational efficiency gains.
* Demonstrated ability to influence cross\-functional partners and leadership across a global team to drive operational improvements, particularly in ambiguous environments where engaged priorities exist.
* Strong executive leadership presentation skills with the ability to communicate effectively to executive stakeholders.

**About the job**
-----------------


A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.


As a Business Strategy and Operations Program Manager, you will be a pivotal member of our enablement team, dedicated to removing friction and minimizing administrative burden for our Data Center Operations (DCOps) field teams. Your mission is to provide the operational clarity and process support necessary for our field teams to maintain focus on delivering operational excellence. Your responsibilities will include streamlining the OKR process, simplifying the Rhythm of Business (RoB), and executing a two\-way communication strategy that ensures field challenges are heard and addressed by leadership. You will require a service\-oriented mindset, focused on empowering our technical teams to work effectively by reducing the complexity and confusion that often accompany large\-scale operations.


Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $188000 \- $274000 (USD) \+ 20% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Act as a team multiplier for our field teams by proactively identifying and eliminating operational bottlenecks and administrative friction that impede their daily work.
* Own the end\-to\-end OKR process for the organization, leading the setup, tracking, and alignment of OKRs while ensuring that objectives are clear, relevant to field needs, and designed to minimize reporting overhead.
* Organize and facilitate the regular meetings that keep the organization aligned, ensuring discussions are productive, and that critical blockers are identified and cleared.
* Build trusted partnerships across cross\-functional groups to drive operational improvements and ensure that initiatives are designed with business needs in mind.
* Look for ways to simplify how we work.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.title: Manager of People Operations (Bilingual, HR & Labor Relations)
jobs.description:
Pritchard Sports \& Entertainment Group seeks a Bilingual Manager of People Operations to manage day\-to\-day HR, personnel, payroll coordination, labor relations and office administration for a cleaning services account, venue. This hands\-on role supports a unionized hourly workforce, partners with site leadership and the client, and helps ensure staffing readiness and People readiness.


**Reports to:** Vice President of People Operations (HR), with functional guidance from the Site Manager


**People operations and workforce support**


* Partner with Recruiting and Operations on staffing needs, hiring, on site onboarding and retention. Complete and process new\-hire forms and required employment documentation; maintain accurate UKG (HRIS) records and confidential personnel files.
* Maintain current staffing rosters, vacancies and weekly termination reports. Coordinate timely separation processing with HR and Payroll, including required final\-pay information.
* Work with team leaders, supervisors and managers to evaluate performance and staffing needs; recommend adjustments for Site Manager approval and coordinate labor and materials readiness for assigned work.
* Conduct on site orientations, coordinate, facilitate employee and supervisor training, and track completion. Administer site benefit, incentive and recognition programs, including the Pin Ceremony, with corporate partners.
* Build trusted, supportive relationships with employees while maintaining professional boundaries and ensuring fair, consistent treatment.
* Coach leaders on attendance, performance, documentation and employee communication; remain accessible across shifts and coordinate appropriate workplace matters with the client while protecting confidential information.


**Union relations and employee investigations**


* Maintain productive relationships with union representatives and stewards. Administer collective bargaining agreements (CBAs) and guide leaders on seniority, manage seniority list, assignments and discipline.
* Manage grievance intake, fact\-finding, deadlines, meetings and documentation; recommend responses and resolutions with the Site Manager and VP of HR. Escalate settlements and contract commitments for approval.
* Conduct impartial investigations into employee concerns, harassment, discrimination, retaliation and policy violations. Document findings, recommend action and monitor follow\-up; escalate sensitive matters to the VP of HR and legal counsel.
* Review proposed discipline and terminations for policy and CBA consistency. Train supervisors on union interactions and support negotiations, mediation or arbitration with records and case preparation as assigned.


**Payroll and office administration**


* Prepare and process site payroll submissions in partnership with Payroll. Review timekeeping processes, attendance, pay adjustments, CBA pay provisions and approvals; resolve discrepancies and maintain accurate payroll records.
* Manage office administration, including correspondence, copying, filing. Use HRIS and office software to prepare reports and track deliverables.
* Maintain purchase\-order files, invoices, daily billing and billing reports; reconcile supporting documentation and coordinate timely approvals and submission with Operations and Finance.


**Claims and incident coordination**


* Maintain site insurance documentation, Workers’ Compensation records and injury, accident and General Liability reports. Collect incident details, witness statements and supporting records for timely submission to Risk and Safety.
* Track claims and missing documentation; coordinate work status, restrictions and return\-to\-work requirements with HR, Operations, Risk and Safety under approved guidance.


**Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* Five or more years of progressive HR experience, including at least two years of hands\-on union relations, CBA administration and grievance management.
* Experience conducting investigations, coaching supervisors, supporting a large hourly workforce and coordinating payroll. Sports venues, hospitality, facilities services or event operations experience preferred.
* Working knowledge of California and San Francisco employment law and requirements; sound judgment, confidentiality, attention to detail and strong project coordination skills.
* Advanced Microsoft Office skills, including Excel, and proficiency with HRIS, timekeeping and reporting systems; UKG experience preferred. Ability to work effectively with employees, leaders, clients and vendors.
* Ability to work on site across multiple shifts, including evenings, weekends and holidays, to support the venue’s event schedule.


**Benefits**


* **Salary: $100,000– $110,000 Annually based on experience.**
* **Schedule: On Site; some evenings, some weekends and some holidays aligned with events**
* Health Benefits Package
* Ancillary benefits—Life insurance, Long Term Disability, FSA, and Dependent Spending care
* 401K
* Opportunity for growth


**Pritchard Industries participates in E\-Verify.**

Preferred* Thought Provoking: Capable of making others think deeply on a subject
* Functional Expert: Considered a thought leader on a subject
* Team Player: Works well as a member of a group
* Detail Oriented: Capable of carrying out a given task with all details necessary to get the task done well

jobs.title: Assistant Bakery Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**ABOUT INSOMNIA:**



Insomnia Cookies was founded in a college dorm room by then\-student, Seth Berkowitz. Fast forward 20 years and so... many....cookies... later, our innovative bakery \+ delivery concept has become a cult brand known for its rabid following of cookie lovers who crave Insomnia’s warm, delicious delivery all day and late into the night. With an expanding footprint of over 350 stores globally, an experiential, “sweet\-easy” flagship concept, and large scale operations and delivery capabilities ... Insomnia Cookies is revolutionizing the cookie game by truly "Imagining What’s Possible"!

  


Insomnia Cookies is actively hiring for a full\-time hourly Store Manager in Training (MIT) at our Dallas \- Victory Park store and we are seeking hospitality focused individuals looking to join our industry leading, rapidly growing, nationally recognized company!

**ABOUT THE ROLE:**



At Insomnia Cookies, warm is more than how we serve our cookies—it’s how we show up for our guests, our teams, and each other.



As an Assistant Bakery Operations Manager (ABOM), you’ll help bring that to life every day by working side\-by\-side with your Bakery Operations Manager to build an energized, well\-trained team, create unforgettable guest experiences, and keep the bakery running at its best. You’ll coach and develop people, jump in wherever you’re needed, and take real ownership of the details that make a great bakery great—from staffing and inventory to quality, cleanliness, and execution. And when the BOM isn’t there, you’ll be ready to step up and lead.



This role is built for someone who wants more than an assistant manager job: it’s an opportunity to learn the business, grow as a leader, and develop the skills and confidence to one day run an Insomnia bakery of your own.


**WHAT YOU’LL DO:**



As a key member of the bakery leadership team, you will:


* Partner with your BOM to lead day\-to\-day bakery operations and deliver an exceptional guest experience.
* Lead the bakery independently when the BOM is away, keeping the team focused and operations running smoothly.
* Coach, motivate, and develop Shift Leaders and Cookie Crew members through real\-time feedback, recognition, and support.
* Support recruiting, interviewing, onboarding, and training to build a strong, fully staffed team.
* Help create schedules and manage labor to meet the needs of the bakery and the business.
* Support ordering, inventory management, product rotation, and shrink control.
* Maintain high standards for product quality, food safety, cleanliness, speed of service, and overall bakery execution.
* Complete required operational and administrative tasks accurately and on time.
* Identify opportunities to improve bakery performance and partner with your BOM and Area leadership to put solutions into action.
* Help create a culture where team members know what’s expected, feel supported, and are accountable for delivering their best.
* Jump in wherever needed—from serving guests and baking cookies to supporting the team during our busiest hours.


**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:**


* 1\+ year of leadership experience in retail, restaurant, hospitality, or another customer\-focused environment.
* Experience coaching, motivating, and developing hourly team members.
* Strong communication, organization, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, team\-oriented environment.
* A hands\-on leadership style and willingness to jump into any bakery role when needed.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple operational priorities.
* Passion for delivering exceptional guest experiences and building great teams.
* Must be 18 years of age or older.
* Ability to obtain any required food safety certifications applicable to the location.
* Ability to perform the essential functions of the position with or without reasonable accommodation.


**Physical Requirements**



This position regularly requires the ability to:


* Stand and walk for extended periods of time (up to 8 hours per shift).
* Frequently reach, bend, stoop, twist, kneel, and lift.
* Lift, carry, push, and pull up to 30 pounds regularly.
* Occasionally lift up to 50 pounds with assistance.
* Use hands and fingers to handle bakery equipment, food products, and a point\-of\-sale system.
* Work in environments with varying temperatures, including around ovens, freezers, and refrigeration units.
* Safely operate kitchen equipment in accordance with company procedures.
* Read order screens, recipes, and safety information.
* Communicate effectively with guests and team members in a fast\-paced environment.


**Work Environment**



This position works in a fast\-paced bakery environment that includes frequent interaction with guests, exposure to heat from ovens, refrigerated storage areas, cleaning chemicals, and moderate noise levels. Evening, late\-night, weekend, and holiday shifts are a regular part of the business.


**Schedule Expectations**



Our bakeries are busiest during evenings, late nights, weekends, and holidays. Team Members should have availability during these peak business hours. Scheduling needs vary by location.


**Equal Employment Opportunity**



Insomnia Cookies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable federal, state, or local law.


**Reasonable Accommodation**



If you require a reasonable accommodation during any part of the application or hiring process, please let us know. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.


**Additional Information**

jobs.title: Assistant Critical Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**THE COMPANY:**


STACK INFRASTRUCTURE (STACK) provides digital infrastructure to scale the world’s most innovative companies. We are an award\-winning industry leader in building, owning, and operating highly efficient, cost\-effective wholesale, colocation, and cloud data centers. Each of our national facilities meets or exceeds the highest industry standards in all operational categories of availability, security, connectivity, and physical resilience.


STACK offers the scale and geographic reach that rapidly growing hyperscale and enterprise companies need. The world runs on data. Data runs on STACK.

**THE POSITION:**


STACK is looking for an Assistant Critical Operations Manager (ACOM) to support a local data center campus. As a leader in STACK’s Critical Operations team, the ACOM must possess an expert level of knowledge and will be responsible for assisting the Critical Operations Manager in maintaining the mechanical, electrical, fire life safety, base building, and other various internal data center systems. The ACOM will also be focused on the implementation of programs related to Safety, Team, Availability, Communication, and Knowledge. The Assistant Critical Operations Manager will report to the Critical Operations Manager.


The ACOM is responsible for the implementation of the Data Center Operations Program at their site and is responsible for employee training and ensuring all staff is adequately qualified to perform their duties. Holding regular team meetings and individual 1:1 sessions is required. The ACOM will assist the Critical Operations Manager in developing and maintaining CAPEX and OPEX budgets at the site level. They will also be responsible for project execution and management including developing scopes, obtaining proposals, creating purchase requisitions, and ensuring invoices are routed properly.


Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

* Lead and implement a standardized culture of always working safely across all STACK data centers.
* Serve as a datacenter subject matter expert for electrical, mechanical, fire life safety, and other data center systems.
* Operate, monitor, maintain, and respond to abnormal conditions within the facility.
* Implement site\-level efficiency projects and maintain overall site design PUE.
* Ensure STACK preventative and predictive maintenance program is executed.
* Train and mentor junior staff.
* Manage vendor relationships and service contracts.
* Assist in managing vendor procurement and billing processes.
* Support site budgeting and forecasting for both CapEx and OpEx.
* Create highly detailed technical procedures for maintenance events, emergency situations, and standard site evolutions.
* Perform expert technical review of procedures, company standards, and policies.
* Manage site audits, both internal and external, ensuring adherence to compliance standards.
* Manage systems to avoid unplanned, customer\-impacting outages.
* Manage the data floor and back\-of\-house mechanical loading capacity to ensure cooling system efficiency.
* Navigate and utilize CMS, EPMS, and BMS systems.
* Provide day\-to\-day exceptional customer service and support.
* Be available on\-call as required to respond to emergency situations at the data center.
* Perform other duties as required by STACK. Job duties, roles, and responsibilities are subject to change over time.

**THE DETAILS:**

* **Location: San Jose, CA**
* **Travel:** None or less than 5%
* **Benefits:** Healthcare, Dental Care, Vision Insurance, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, and Paid Leave Programs
* Must be eligible to work in the United States
* Must pass comprehensive background and drug screening

**MUST\-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS:**

* High school diploma or equivalent

jobs.description:
Job Title: Operations Supervisor (Equipment and Sanitation)  
Job Location: San Francisco\-USA\-94128  
Work Location Type: On\-Site  
Salary Range: $75,000\.00 \- 85,000\.00  


About us  
Since 1942, SkyChefs has taken culinary excellence to new heights. As a trusted partner to the nation’s leading airlines and retailers, we proudly deliver millions of meals and exceptional service experiences every year across 43 sites throughout the United States. Built on a legacy of operational excellence, culinary expertise, and continuous innovation, we are committed to setting the industry standard in aviation culinary, airline services, last\-mile logistics, and retail commerce. From the kitchen to the runway, our teams work together to deliver quality, reliability, and service at every altitude. Our people are the heart of everything we do. At SkyChefs, a career is more than a job – it’s an opportunity to grow, lead, and make an impact in a fast\-paced, team\-driven environment. Join America’s first, foremost, and finest and take your career to new heights.  
Role Purpose Statement  


The Equipment \& Sanitation (E\&S) Supervisor is responsible for overseeing equipment flow and deliveries to all departments, ensuring equipment is cleaned properly and delivered in a timely manner. This role plays a critical part in maintaining operational efficiency, food safety, and sanitation standards throughout the facility.  


We are seeking a proactive leader who can balance people management, operational execution, and sanitation compliance while ensuring equipment availability and workflow efficiency across the operation.  


Main Accountabilities  


How You'll Make a Difference  


* Supervise, train, and schedule E\&S production staff to meet daily output goals.
* Monitor inventory levels, order supplies, and ensure proper maintenance of equipment.
* Identify bottlenecks, document processes, and implement improvements to enhance efficiency.
* Oversee the equipment and sanitation operations, maintaining quality control, and ensuring on\-time delivery
* Run daily huddles to keep everyone focused and energized
* Enforce strict adherence to HACCP, FDA, USDA, and OSHA regulations, ensuring proper temperature controls and hygiene.
* Optimize staffing and schedules to hit productivity and cost goals
* Implement innovative solutions to improve workflow and reduce waste
* Ensure every flight is catered accurately and on schedule
* Jump in on special projects and company initiatives to make an impact
* Motivate, coach, and develop your team while living our company values

Leadership  


Guide, motivate and develop staff within the Human Resources policies  
Make the company's values and management principles live in the department(s)  
Manage productivity hours and costs in the area of responsibility; initiate and steer corrective actions in case of deviations  
Participate and support company sponsored initiatives such as Quality, HACCP, Lean Manufacturing, Employee Safety and Production systems  
Knowledge, Skills and Experience  


* 1\-3\+ years in a food production environment
* Strong understanding of HACCP protocols, and food safety regulations.
* Excellent problem\-solving, leadership, and communication skills
* Experience with Microsoft Office and production management systems
* Experience leading teams and managing schedules in a manufacturing or distribution setting with a hands\-on, solutions\-oriented mindset.
* Ability to manage competing priorities and lead under pressure in a deadline\-driven environment.

\#LSGNS  


SkyChefs is an EEO and Affirmative Action Employer of Women/Minorities/Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities.

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Operations Manager**


Rental Operations\- Hayward, CA


**About Med One Group:**


Med One Group, a leader in the medical equipment rental and finance industry for over 25 years, is seeking a self\-motivated Operations Manager to lead our distribution warehouse in Hayward, CA. This is a full\-time, salaried position with a starting base salary of $80,000\-$95,000, depending on experience.


In this role, you will oversee day\-to\-day warehouse operations while partnering closely with the Sales team to ensure exceptional customer service and operational excellence. The Operations Manager provides leadership, direction, and development to a team responsible for medical equipment processing, delivery coordination, scheduling, inventory management, and customer service.


**Essential Functions:**


* Thrive in a fast\-paced environment.
* Establish clear, measurable goals aligned with organizational objectives, ensuring strong alignment between people, processes, and strategy to drive consistent execution.
* Set high performance standards, hold teams accountable, and ensure full compliance with all policies and procedures.
* Lead by example by demonstrating a positive, committed approach to the business, colleagues, cross\-functional partners, direct reports, and clients.
* Collaborate with Sales and leadership to deliver customer\-focused, win\-win solutions.
* Build and strengthen customer relationships in close partnership with the Sales team.
* Oversee facility operations, including warehouse and office organization, cleanliness, supply inventory, coordination with home office IT, business licenses, and relationships with local property management.
* Apply strong business and financial acumen by managing contracts and overseeing Profit \& Loss (P\&L) statements and budgets to support account profitability.
* Drive continuous improvement across processes, products, and services while embracing innovation, change, and adaptability.
* Maintain flexibility to work evenings, weekends, holidays, and emergency off\-hours as business needs require.
* Participate in an on\-call rotation and respond to after\-hours calls as needed to support staff and operations.


**Job Requirements**


* Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience in warehouse operations, operations management, or a supervisory role.
* 3 to 5 years of leadership experience with a demonstrated ability to motivate teams, work independently, and take initiative. Experience in the medical equipment rental industry is preferred.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the proven ability to build relationships and deliver excellent customer service.
* Proficiency with PC\-based applications, excellent organizational skills, and strong attention to detail.


**Additional Information:**


Med One offers a great work environment with a team of dedicated coworkers who take pride in what they do. We offer a competitive salary and a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, and vision insurance, as well as a Health Savings Account partially funded by Med One. Additional benefits include life insurance, short\- and long\-term disability coverage, and a 401(k) plan through Vanguard, which employees are eligible to contribute to beginning on the first of the month following 30 days of employment. After one year of service, Med One matches 401(k) contributions up to 5%. We also offer paid time off, holiday pay, and a quarterly performance\-based bonus.


If you're a motivated leader who thrives in a collaborative, customer\-focused environment, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Operations Manager-CA
jobs.description:
We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

**Position Summary**  

The Operations Manager is a member of the Store Management team, and as such, fulfills the company purpose of helping people on their path to better health by driving store execution and performance while building consumer loyalty to CVS/pharmacy through a focus on excellent customer service. Under the supervision of the Store Manager, the Operations Manager will maintain an engaged, productive store team through strong leadership, demonstrating initiative and leading by example.


The Operations Manager is responsible for supporting the Store Manager in the total leadership and strategic operation of a CVS/pharmacy store including:

* Overall store management, supervision, and policy implementation
* Sales and inventory management
* Employee staffing, training, and development
* Financial management
* Customer service leadership

Unlike the Store Manager in Training position, the Operations Manager position is not part of the CVS/pharmacy Retail Management Development Program. Operations Managers are not eligible for direct promotion to Store Manager. Candidates with a short\-term goal of becoming a CVS Store Manager should instead apply for Store Manager in Training openings.


Essential Functions:


1\. Management


Lead others and work effectively with store crews


Supervise, assign and direct activities of the store’s crew


Effectively communicate information to store crew and supervisors in an open and timely manner


Support Store Manager with actions plans for operational and service improvement


2\. Customer Service


Assist customers with their questions, problems and complaints


Promote CVS customer service culture (greet, offer help, and thank)

 **Required Qualifications**
Deductive reasoning ability, advanced analytical skills and computer skills.


Advanced communication skills, leadership, supervision, and influencing skill


Ability to work a full\-time flexible schedule, including some early morning, overnight and weekend shifts, to work overtime as needed, and to respond to urgent issues at the store when they arise  



  

**Preferred Qualifications**
Experience as a retail manager or supervisor

 **Education**
High school diploma or equivalent required

**Anticipated Weekly Hours**


40**Time Type**


Full time**Pay Range**


The typical pay range for this role is:


$23\.65 \- $37\.65
This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full\-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors.

  

Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong.

**Great benefits for great people**


We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families.

  

This full‑time position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues and their families. The benefits for this position include medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, retirement savings options, wellness programs, and other resources, based on eligibility.  

Additional details about available benefits are provided during the application process and on Benefits Moments.

  

We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on: 11/24/2026
Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state and local laws.

jobs.title: Recruiting Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About** **Nooks.ai****:**
===========================


Nooks is an applied AI lab building the Agent Workspace for GTM. We design AI agents that operate across the full sales action set, from *account strategy* to *prospect research* and *outreach*. Building 0 1 has never been easier, but selling at the speed of the market remains the last frontier for AI. Our mission is to 10x every seller by automating the busywork so they can focus on what humans do best: closing deals.


Today, over 1,500 customers run on Nooks, including Notion, HubSpot, Cursor, and Rippling. We’ve raised $70M\+ from top VCs like Kleiner Perkins, which made its first sales\-tech investment in over a decade with us. Since then, we’ve tripled ARR each year for 3 years running and grown a high\-caliber team turning the art of sales into a scalable science.

**Recruiting Operations Manager**
=================================


Nook's is looking for a Recruiting Operations Manager to help build the systems, programs, and infrastructure that enable our recruiting organization to scale.


This is a highly cross\-functional, high\-ownership role for someone who loves making things better. You’ll sit at the intersection of Recruiting, People, Marketing, and the broader business — using data, technology, AI, and strong program management to improve how we attract, engage, and hire great talent.

**What You’ll Own**
-------------------

### **1\. Recruiting Operations**

* Own recruiting processes, reporting, analytics, and operating rhythms.
* Turn recruiting data into insights and actionable improvements.
* Manage and optimize our recruiting technology and vendor ecosystem, including security, billing, adoption, and training.
* Research and implement new tools and technologies that improve recruiter productivity and candidate experience.
* Drive the adoption of AI across recruiting, including evaluating new use cases and implementing Nooks Agent.
* Lead strategic research projects to help us make better, data\-driven recruiting decisions.
* Help develop and strengthen Nooks’ recruiting/employer brand and equip the team with consistent messaging and tools.
* Create leverage across the recruiting team through better systems, automation, processes, and team enablement.

### **2\. Talent Events \& Programs**


Own or support talent\-focused events and programs that strengthen Nooks’ brand and talent pipeline, including:

* Hackathons and technical events
* Conferences and industry events
* Nooks\-hosted events and dinners
* University and community events
* Creative new ways to get Nooks in front of exceptional talent


Partner cross\-functionally with Marketing, Recruiting, Engineering, and other teams to maximize the impact of these efforts.

### **3\. People Operations Partnership**


Partner with People Operations to ensure Recruiting and People processes scale together.


You’ll help:

* Implement and communicate new processes effectively.
* Identify when teams need training, documentation, or enablement.
* Improve cross\-functional workflows and eliminate operational friction.
* Support strategic People projects where your expertise can create leverage.

### **4\. University Programs**


Own and accelerate Nooks’ university recruiting strategy, with a particular focus on engineering talent.


You’ll build relationships with universities and technical communities, develop programs and events, measure results, and create a scalable pipeline of exceptional early\-career talent. You’ll partner with recruiters and hiring teams as needed while maintaining ownership of the overall program.

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

* Experience in Recruiting Operations, Talent Operations, People Operations, Recruiting, Program Management, or a similar function.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and project management skills.
* Experience building processes or programs from the ground up.
* Curiosity and enthusiasm for AI and emerging recruiting technology.
* Ability to manage systems, vendors, and multiple cross\-functional initiatives.
* Strong communication and stakeholder\-management skills.
* A bias toward action and a willingness to operate in ambiguity.
* Someone who naturally looks for ways to create leverage, automate work, and make teams better.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------


You’ll make Nooks’ recruiting organization **more scalable, data\-driven, technology\-enabled, and effective**.


You’ll help us spend less time on manual work, make better decisions with better data, get more value from our technology, build a stronger talent brand, create new talent pipelines, and give the recruiting team the leverage they need to focus on what they do best: **hiring exceptional people.**

------------------------------------------


Nooks is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workforce. We believe in providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.


Nooks does not discriminate in hiring, promotion, compensation, or any other employment practices, and we are committed to ensuring a workplace that is free from discrimination, harassment, and retaliation. We encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply and join our team.

jobs.description:
**About Airwallex**
-------------------


Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.


Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world\-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. jobs.title: Escalations Manager, Global Response Operations
jobs.description:
Global Response Operations (GRO) is Meta's frontline defense against threats to platform integrity, user safety, regulatory compliance, and advertiser support. The Response teams solve essential escalations, remediate the most critical issues, and respond to urgent risks and incidents. We respond when the stakes are highest: high\-priority escalations that demand speed, precision, coordination, and judgement. We work closely with our partners to fix gaps in our platforms. Our mandate is to manage complex and novel situations that require special care across Meta's Family of Apps, all surfaces and domains, all issue types and all user groups. We are transitioning to an agentic operating model where AI handles routine work and human experts focus on the cases, decisions, and system improvements that require judgment, creativity, and domain depth.You will own Meta's most complex, sensitive, and time\-critical escalations, where AI reaches its limits and expert human judgment determines the outcome. Working across all Meta surfaces, products, and issue types, you'll investigate and resolve high\-stakes situations spanning civic concerns, entertainment events, advertiser integrity, regulatory risk, and AI product failures. You'll serve as a domain expert and workflow contributor by designing how humans and AI work together, critically evaluating AI outputs, encoding your expertise into systems that scale, and supporting others to do the same. You'll lead or contribute to pods that drive measurable operational improvement. This role is for people who thrive in ambiguity, adapt quickly to shifting priorities, and see AI as a force multiplier for better outcomes.This role requires review of content, issues and matters that can be offensive or disturbing, including but not limited to graphic violence, self\-harm, hate speech, abuse, and sexually explicit material. Meta provides resources and support for employees who work with sensitive content. This role will require regular scheduled weekend and holiday on\-call work, and some non\-scheduled crisis intervention.

* \*\*Response \& Crisis Management\*\*\*
* Drive Meta's highest\-priority escalations to resolution: from initial triage through investigation, cross\-functional coordination, and final resolution, ensuring time\-sensitive cases are mitigated within SLA and with minimal business or reputational impact
* Conduct rigorous, multi\-system investigations: connect signals across surfaces and stakeholders on complex or novel case types (LLM hallucinations, AI agent misbehavior, deepfake/synthetic media, cross\-platform integrity failures), producing root cause analysis and documentation that prevents recurrence
* Coordinate across Policy, Legal, Engineering, Sales, Communications, Leadership, and other XFN: drive aligned response strategies on cases carrying reputational, legal, or business risk, translating complexity into clear decisions and accountable next steps
* Synthesize and deliver executive\-level communications: leverage AI to ensure accurate, actionable situational awareness reaches leadership and partners when it matters
* Exercise judgment on unprecedented situations: make high\-stakes calls and set precedent for continuous improvement

* Lead or contribute to sprints and pods that transform operations: drive measurable improvements in efficiency, effectiveness, and performance outcomes
* Design and iterate on AI\-assisted workflows (prompts, decision trees, runbooks, automations): increase team throughput, measured by reduced handling time, enhanced outcomes, or eliminated manual steps for recurring case patterns
* Support peer development on judgment, AI tool mastery, and escalation calibration: share expertise through case reviews and real\-time modeling, contributing to the team's collective capability
* Conduct case quality reviews: identify patterns in errors and AI failures
* implement corrections that raise the bar for the team
* \*\*AI Judging and Design\*\*\*
* Critically evaluate AI\-generated assessments, investigation outputs, and recommended actions: correct and document failure patterns, feeding structured improvements back into the system so accuracy improves over time
* Identify when regulatory, policy, or operational context changes require capability updates: proactively flag when existing automation rules, prompts, or decision logic have become stale due to external shifts, ensuring systems reflect current reality
* Provide structured feedback on AI launches: deliver actionable recommendations for improvement based on operational experience
* Design escalation logic, runbooks, and decision trees for AI systems: define how AI handles edge cases and when it routes to humans
* Create and maintain AI prompts, playbooks, and evaluation rubrics: build the tooling layer that governs AI performance in your domain
* Test and validate new AI capabilities before deployment: ensure quality and reliability before workflows go live
* Design AI skills and capabilities to check and copilot human work: build manual and human\-in\-the\-loop quality mechanisms into operational processes

jobs.description:
Apple’s Partner Operations team is seeking an experienced, highly collaborative, and technically astute Program Manager to lead platform capability expansion across our Apple services partnerships.  

  

**Description**  

  

In this role, you will bridge business strategy, technical integration, and partner execution. You will guide global partners\-spanning telecommunications carriers, subscription video on demand (SVOD) providers, and retail integrators\-through the onboarding lifecycle, ensuring they can seamlessly adopt new platform capabilities. You will operate comfortably in the gray, translate complex commerce and linking architectures into actionable operational workflows, and drive alignment across Business Development, Engineering, Product, QA, Marketing, Legal, and more. You will also continue to refine parter onboarding and management processes and tools, utilizing innovative approaches \- knowing when to use technical tools such as AI while understanding the necessity for face to face collaboration. ","responsibilities":"You will own the end\-to\-end operational lifecycle for new platform features and major partner launches. Your core responsibilities include:  

  

Platform Capability \& Feature Onboarding  

  

Drive Partner Adoption of Platform Capabilities: Lead the operational rollout and partner adoption for emerging features to our billing platform.  

  

Partner with product and engineering teams to establish operational readiness for novel subscription bundling models (e.g., streaming and carrier bundles), tier upgrades/downgrades via update\-entitlement APIs, and multi\-country configurations.  

  

Define Migration \& Sunset Flows (CIP to Direct): Own the Partner Ops workstream for transitioning subscribers between partner\-billed and Apple\-direct models, defining end\-to\-end operational requirements, PVT validation flows, and subscription cancellation/revocation procedures.  

  

Technical Operations  

  

Lead Production Verification \& Testing Strategy: Partner with Commerce QA and Central Marketing UAT to define and execute comprehensive PVT plans; coordinate partner dependencies, including test SIM sourcing, test accounts, and allowlisting.  

  

Investigate Discrepancies \& Resolve Blockers: Triage operational and technical blockers impacting partner launches (e.g., deep\-link localization/offer sheet display issues, tax ID formatting on partner invoicing, missing commerce signals, and account unlinking edge cases).  

  

Operational Infrastructure \& Scalability  

  

Oversee intake trackers from the partner ops team and roadmap requests for platform enhancements; prioritize requests with engineering and product teams to balance partner velocity with long\-term platform health.  

  

Standardize Governance \& Enablement: Partner with regional teams (AMR, EMEIA, APAC) and integrators to deliver consistent integration best practices, partner capability trackers, and onboarding toolkits.  

  

Drive Process Automation: Identify manual intervention points across the onboarding lifecycle and work cross\-functionally to transition them into automated, self\-serve, and scalable tools.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**  

  

BA/BS degree required; technical, engineering, or business operations background preferred.  

  

8\+ years of relevant industry experience in technical program management, partner operations, or systems integration.  

  

Experience in telecommunications carrier billing, digital streaming services (OTT/SVOD), or digital commerce platforms is strongly preferred.  

  

**Minimum Qualifications**  

  

8\+ years of technical program or operations management experience driving complex, partner\-facing integrations, digital customer journeys, and back\-end platform capabilities.  

  

Deep familiarity with subscription lifecycle mechanics, recurring billing, and API\-driven partner integrations  

  

Proven track record in end\-to\-end partner onboarding \& operational readiness, from defining intake processes and writing operational requirements to coordinating production verification testing (PVT/UAT).  

  

Strong cross\-functional orchestration skills, with the demonstrated ability to lead workstreams across Engineering, Product, Business Development, Commerce/Billing, Legal/Privacy, and Regional Operations teams globally.  

  

Strong analytical and problem\-solving aptitude, with experience troubleshooting back\-end event triggers, signaling mechanisms, and data\-flow discrepancies across multi\-party ecosystems.  

  

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, capable of presenting technical concepts clearly to executive leadership, authoring partner\-facing integration guides, and managing multi\-stakeholder operational reviews.  

  

**Pay \& Benefits**  

  

At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $149,700 and $225,600, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.  

  

Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple's discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You'll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses \- including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits
