jobs.title: Technical Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
### **About Northbeam**



Northbeam is building the world's most advanced marketing intelligence platform, providing top eCommerce brands a unified view of their business data through powerful attribution modeling and customizable dashboards. Our technology helps customers accurately track ad spend, understand the full customer journey, and drive profitable growth. Machine learning has been at the heart of Northbeam since day one: our full suite of measurement, spanning multi\-touch attribution, MMM\+, and incrementality, is built on it, along with laser\-accurate first\-party data. Now we're taking that foundation further, using AI to help brands operationalize their data and turn Northbeam insights into automated decisions.



We're experiencing rapid growth, have strong product\-market fit, and are looking for the right people to help us scale. This is a rare chance to make a meaningful impact at a fast\-moving, high\-growth company. At Northbeam, you'll join a team of driven, collaborative, and talented individuals who value personal growth and excellence. We'd love for you to be part of our journey.



We're a remote\-friendly company with physical offices in San Francisco and Los Angeles.


### **About the Role**



We're looking for a Technical Implementation Specialist to own the hands\-on onboarding and technical setup of new customers. You'll work directly with customers to configure the product, integrate data sources, and get them to first value as quickly and smoothly as possible.



This role is ideal for someone who enjoys being customer\-facing and technical; part consultant, part builder, part project manager.


### **Your Impact**



Customer Onboarding \& Implementation


* Lead the end\-to\-end implementation for new customers, acting as the primary technical guide from kickoff through go\-live
* Configure product settings, permissions, and workflows
* Subject matter expert for API integrations and data migration
* Troubleshoot setup issues and coordinate with Support or Engineering as needed


Project Management


* Own onboarding timelines, milestones, and deliverables
* Manage customer expectations and keep implementations on track
* Communicate progress, risks, and next steps clearly


Internal Collaboration


* Partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Support
* Provide feedback on onboarding friction, product gaps, and common blockers
* Contribute to onboarding documentation and implementation playbooks

### **What You Bring**


* Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, or related field
* 2\+ years of experience in SaaS implementation
* 2\+ years in solutions engineering and technical onboarding
* Experience in customer\-facing technical roles
* Comfortable with:
	+ APIs, integrations, frontend technologies, and data concepts
	+ Software troubleshooting and problem\-solving
	+ Technical conversations with non\-technical stakeholders
	+ Managing multiple high\-impact projects concurrently
* Strong project management and communication skills
* Detail\-oriented, organized, and calm under pressure

### **Bonus Skills \& Experience**


* Bonus: experience with analytics, martech, data platforms, or attribution tools


\#LI\-Remote



Actual compensation may vary based on experience, skills, and location.



In addition to your base salary, we offer an equity package, comprehensive healthcare benefits (medical, dental, and vision), and a 401(k) plan. Our team enjoys a flexible PTO policy, 12 company\-paid holidays, and 12 weeks of paid parental leave. We also provide a $500 work\-from\-home stipend to support your remote setup.


**Interview Process**  

The interview process varies by role but typically begins with a 30\-minute interview with a Northbeam recruiter, followed by a video interview with the hiring manager. Next, candidates complete a role\-specific video interview followed by video or onsite interviews with several team members. The final step is a video interview with our CEO/Co\-founder. The entire interview process is usually 5\-7 interviews total and requires around 5\-8 hours of your time.



We accept applications on an ongoing basis.

jobs.title: Contract Project Manager (Evergreen)
jobs.description:
Interested in joining Blue State's Media Team? Submit your application here to ensure you're first in line for future opportunities. Please note: this is an "evergreen" job post (i.e. not an active job post), but your expression of interest matters to us. While interviews aren't ongoing, we're excited to connect with talented individuals who share our commitment to Blue State's mission.


**If you came across this job via LinkedIn, please note that it is an evergreen role; Linked In does not differentiate, but we prefer to.**

**What to know**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


**Help run website development projects transforming the way people engage.** As a Project Manager, you'll spend your days leading our website development and technical consulting projects from start to finish, which will include managing clients, and collaborating with diverse teams of UXers, Designers, Strategists, and Developers. You'll help turn progressive ideas into actionable tactics, timelines, budgets, and deliverables.


**The company**
---------------



Blue State is a purpose\-driven agency. We partner with leading causes, brands, and campaigns and create real change. From AARP and Doctors Without Borders to Amnesty International and Oxfam, we transform how brands and causes raise money, influence policy, build platforms, and grow communities of supporters. Led by the most creative and analytical minds from the political, nonprofit, and brand worlds, Blue State is an independent agency in the US and London.

jobs.title: Project Manager, Configuration Management
jobs.description:
Astranis builds advanced satellites for high orbits, expanding humanity's reach into the solar system. Today Astranis satellites provide dedicated, secure networks to highly\-sophisticated customers across the globe – large enterprises, sovereign governments, and the US military.



With five satellites on orbit and many more set to launch soon, the company is servicing a backlog of more than $1 billion of commercial contracts. Astranis is the preferred satellite communications partner for buyers with stringent requirements for uptime, data security, network visibility, and customization.



Astranis has raised over $1\.2 billion from some of the world's best investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, Baillie Gifford, Blackrock, Fidelity, Franklin Templeton, and Snowpoint, and employs a team of 500 engineers and entrepreneurs. Astranis designs, builds, and operates its satellites out of its 153,000 sq. ft. headquarters in Northern California, USA.

**Project Manager, Configuration Management**



We're looking for a highly organized, detail\-oriented PLM Analyst I to help keep the product data and engineering\-change processes behind our spacecraft moving quickly and accurately. This is an excellent entry\-level opportunity for someone who enjoys structured technical work, thrives on solving operational puzzles, and wants a front\-row seat to how complex hardware is designed, released, built, and improved.



You'll work closely with our PLM team and partners across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and quality. Your core focus will be managing the intake, entry, routing, and quality review of Engineering Change Orders (ECOs), helping ensure that every change to our hardware is documented, reviewed, traceable, and ready for execution.



By owning these essential day\-to\-day workflows, you'll help scale the systems and processes that enable Astranis to build satellites faster and more reliably.


**Role**


* Create, enter, maintain, and track Engineering Change Orders (ECOs) and associated PLM records
* Review ECO submissions for completeness, accuracy, required documentation, and adherence to established naming, revision\-control, and release standards
* Coordinate ECO routing, approvals, and follow\-up across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, quality, and other cross\-functional teams
* Proactively identify stalled, incomplete, or inconsistent change requests and work with stakeholders to keep them moving
* Support the release and revision of parts, assemblies, drawings, bills of materials (BOMs), and related engineering documentation
* Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, and metrics for ECO throughput, backlog, cycle time, and data quality


**Requirements**


* Bachelor's degree in engineering, operations, supply chain, manufacturing, information systems, or another related technical field—or equivalent relevant experience.
* Exceptional attention to detail and a demonstrated ability to perform high\-accuracy, process\-driven work.
* Strong organizational, written, and verbal communication skills.
* Comfort working with structured data, spreadsheets, and technical documentation.
* Ability to manage multiple requests, prioritize effectively, and follow defined
* processes.
* A collaborative approach and comfort working with technical and operational stakeholders.
* Curiosity about how physical products are designed, documented, released, and built.


**Bonus**


* Professional experience supporting engineering, manufacturing, operations, supply chain, quality, or configuration\-management teams.
* Familiarity with product lifecycle management (PLM), enterprise resource planning (ERP), document\-control, ticketing, or workflow\-management systems.
* Exposure to engineering drawings, BOMs, part numbers, revisions, or change\-control processes.
* Interest in aerospace, satellites, or complex hardware development.

We are seeking an AV Program Manager to help drive the cross\-functional operating plan that will prepare Flexdrive to receive, staff, and operate AV fleets at scale domestically and abroad.



This role supports the operational backbone of Flexdrive's AV readiness initiative. You will maintain the program timeline, coordinate cross\-functional workstreams spanning infrastructure, people, fleet operations, treasury, legal, and finance, and help ensure that requirements are tracked, dependencies are surfaced, and deployment milestones are met. jobs.title: Program Manager, Customer Support Enablement
jobs.description:
**What the Role Is**



As the CS Enablement Program Manager, you'll be the business owner of the systems that make both our human agents and AI agents effective, starting with the quality and integrity of the knowledge they rely on. As a highly autonomous, high\-judgment IC, you'll build and continuously improve the knowledge base, SOPs, training, and AI\-powered workflows that underpin Customer Support across Babylist and Babylist Health. You'll bring deep operational rigor and a strong understanding of how AI is changing customer support—using the technology in your own work while designing systems that make it more effective across the organization. This is a greenfield opportunity to build the CS Enablement function at a tech\-first consumer company: identifying where knowledge, policies, and workflows break down, and partnering across CS, BizOps Tech, Product, and Analytics to build a support system that gets smarter and more reliable as we scale.


**Who You Are**


* **Deep expertise in Support Operations, Enablement, or Knowledge Management**: you've owned documentation, workflows, and operational strategy in high\-volume environments.
* **Can build and manage a knowledge base from scratch** (Zendesk, Gladly, Help Scout, Notion, Guru, or similar), organizing content and maintaining accuracy at scale so both humans and AI systems can use it effectively.
* **Can design for a hybrid AI\-agent and human\-agent support organization**: structuring content for AI consumption, writing effective prompts, evaluating output quality, and calling the line between what's automated and what stays human\-owned.
* **Can write clear, usable SOPs** for complex, multi\-step, or edge\-case scenarios, and know when to automate them instead.
* **Can build and deliver training that actually changes how people work**: onboarding, process rollouts, tool adoption, AI workflow enablement.
* **Strong analytical instincts**: you can read support data (ticket trends, contact drivers, resolution times) and turn it into decisions about what to fix, automate, or rebuild.
* **Comfortable being the first person to do this job.** This space doesn't have an established playbook in customer support yet, you'll be creating it.
* **Effective cross\-functional partner** who can work with BizOps, Product, Analytics, and engineering\-adjacent teams to drive real change, not just executing within your own lane.
* **Demonstrated track record of using AI to do your own work better**. At Babylist every team uses AI daily. You're already using it daily to move faster and improve your output, and have real opinions about when it works and when it doesn't.


**How You Will Make An Impact**


* Build the CS Enablement program from the ground up: create the systems that keep agents (human and AI) current on knowledge base, training, and copilot content as product changes accelerate.
* Move support operations from AI\-assisted to AI\-native: rebuild workflows, documentation, and training so AI is the default operating model.
* Build and maintain the knowledge base that serves as the source of truth for both AI systems and human agents, structured for AI consumption and kept accurate as products and policies evolve.
* Close existing content gaps and continuously identify how to reduce unnecessary escalations and drive meaningful improvement in chatbot coverage and resolution rate.
* Lead the implementation of an AI copilot and bring usage to 90%\+ of agent interactions by making the copilot genuinely useful (better source material, better prompt design).
* Build agent confidence through scalable training that teaches people when to trust AI, when to override it, and how to give feedback that improves it.
* Create SOPs for complex scenarios so cases get handled consistently, audit and streamline fragmented workflows, and design new processes with AI built in from the start.
* Partner with the CS Analyst to identify top contact drivers and documentation gaps, then act on them.
* Establish feedback loops with frontline agents so the system keeps improving instead of just when someone notices a problem.


**Why This Role**


* **You'd be defining a role that doesn't have a template yet.** "AI\-native CS enablement" isn't an established discipline in customer support. You won't be applying someone else's playbook, you'll be writing it.
* **The foundation is still forming, and that's the opportunity.** Most of the knowledge base, SOPs, and AI workflows don't exist yet, so the systems you build become how the org operates for years.
* **You'll have real influence on the roadmap, not just execution against it.** You're setting the agenda with BizOps Tech, Product, and Analytics on what gets fixed, automated, and rebuilt next.
* **Your success is directly visible in the numbers that matter to the business**: chatbot deflection, copilot adoption, CSAT. This isn't a support role in the background, it's core to how CS scales.


**About Compensation**



We use a market\-based approach to compensation. The starting salary range for this role is:


**$140,000 to $170,000**



Your starting salary will be based on your location, experience, and qualifications, with increases over time tied to performance, role growth, and internal pay equity.


**Who We Are**



Babylist is the leading platform for expecting and new families. More than 10 million people shop with Babylist every year, making it the go\-to destination for seamless purchasing, guidance, and expert recommendations. As a modern, AI\-forward tech company, Babylist has expanded from a universal registry into a full ecosystem — the Babylist Shop, Babylist Health, Babylist Money, NYC and LA showrooms, branded content, and more — generating $750M in revenue in 2025\. Building the generational brand in baby, Babylist is reshaping the $235B kids and baby market and helping parents feel confident, connected, and cared for at every step.

**Location:** Oakland, CA  

**Duration:** October 26, 2026– October 25, 2027  

**Pay Rate:** $90\.00/hr. W2

The ideal candidate is a strategic leader with a proven track record of delivering large\-scale cloud transformation programs from conception through production deployment. This individual will work closely with Cloud Architecture, Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, DevOps, Application Teams, and Executive Leadership to ensure successful delivery of complex initiatives while maintaining alignment with business objectives, security requirements, compliance standards, and operational excellence.

**Multi\-Cloud Auto\-Patching Programs**
* Lead initiatives focused on automated operating system and middleware patching across AWS, Azure, Azure Local, and hybrid infrastructure platforms.
* Collaborate with architecture, security, and operations teams to establish enterprise patch governance and compliance reporting.
* Drive adoption of automation capabilities utilizing Azure Arc, Azure Update Manager, Azure Policy, AWS Systems Manager, Terraform, and DevOps pipelines.

**Stakeholder \& Executive Management**
* Build strong partnerships with executive leadership, engineering teams, cybersecurity organizations, operations teams, and business units.
* Communicate program status, issues, risks, dependencies, budget performance, and delivery outcomes to senior leadership.
* Develop executive presentations, dashboards, business cases, and strategic recommendations.

**Financial \& Resource Management**

* Track program financials and demonstrate measurable business value and ROI.

**Risk, Compliance \& Governance**
* Establish robust governance frameworks to ensure compliance with cybersecurity, audit, and regulatory requirements.
* Identify program risks proactively and drive mitigation plans across technical and organizational areas.
* Ensure adherence to cloud architecture standards, security controls, operational readiness, and enterprise policies.

**Continuous Improvement \& Innovation**
* Drive adoption of platform engineering, automation, Infrastructure as Code, DevSecOps, and cloud\-native practices.
* Champion process improvements that increase delivery velocity, operational efficiency, reliability, and scalability.
* Promote a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning.

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience with Salesforce (Agentforce) or Google Enterprise for Customers (GECX).
* Experience in defining, designing, and orchestrating Agentic AI solutions within a global support ecosystem.
* Experience leading and owning programs and addressing multi\-dimensional problems.
* Familiarity with Google Cloud Assist (GCA)**.**

**About the job**
-----------------


Google Cloud Support helps customers solve billing and technical problems with a relentless focus on our users. We engage customers across the globe through social outreach and one\-on\-one support for our Google Workspace and Google Cloud products. Our team redefine support and reset industry standards with the same innovative approach that defines Google’s products.


The Platform Solutions and Delivery team sits within Google Cloud Support and is responsible for influencing, owning, and enabling the deployment of critical support systems and tooling rollouts for our global employee and vendor\-managed Support Delivery teams. We prioritize, plan, implement, and measure the success of transformative support systems initiatives across the entire customer support journey.  

  

Our team is focused on transitioning the Cloud Support organization from a fragmented, human\-centric service model toward a centrally observable, agentic execution system. We are seeking an experienced, strategic, and domain\-expert Manager of Support Enablement to be part of this journey.  

  

In this role, you will focus on transforming the support tooling model from assisted to autonomous support. You will lead and drive the Agentic Artificial Intelligence (AI) strategy in the support enablement space, covering case management, troubleshooting tooling, workflow automations, and learning and development tools. This strategy will encompass the federation of specialized AI agents, where governance and maintenance process design are crucial for scaling. You will operate with significant autonomy, driving the investigation of new platforms, proposing tool integrations into autonomous workflows, and acting as the essential bridge between Operations and Engineering to build these solutions.


Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

jobs.title: Sr Professional Services Strategy & Ops Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI\-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.


Join us to put AI to work for people.

 **Job Description** **About the role:**


The Moveworks Professional Services team deploys agentic AI for some of the largest enterprises in the world. As we scale delivery across a fast\-growing partner ecosystem, we're hiring a Services Delivery Operations Manager to own the day\-to\-day operational backbone that keeps our implementation and ongoing services engagements running smoothly.


This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports — a high\-ownership, high\-autonomy seat for an operator who can run the machine (PSA administration, staffing, capacity, partner subcontracting, and partner program intake) so that Services leadership can stay focused on broader strategy and scale. You will be the connective tissue across Professional Services and our delivery partners, and the person the team trusts to keep delivery operations humming.

**What you get to do in this role:**

* Administer and optimize Rocketlane PSA: Act as the operational owner for Rocketlane configuration, project setup, user onboarding, workflow hygiene, and closed/won\-to\-project handoffs; troubleshoot issues quickly and improve system usability, data quality, and adoption across the delivery organization.
* Lead services resource management: Run the operating cadence for staffing, capacity planning, utilization visibility, and backlog alignment across implementation and ongoing services work; connect pipeline, bookings, project demand, skill requirements, and delivery capacity to recommend assignments, identify coverage gaps, and inform subcontractor needs before they impact customer outcomes.
* Coordinate partner and subcontractor delivery operations: Run the operating process for partner\-subcontracted delivery, from intake and assignment through onboarding, execution tracking, issue resolution, and process improvement.
* Streamline partner program intake: Manage partner program submissions and operational requests with clear SLAs, clean handoffs, and consistent follow\-through so onboarding and engagement readiness move without friction.
* Build operational reporting and delivery insights: Develop recurring dashboards, scorecards, and exception reports that give Services leadership actionable visibility into delivery health, utilization, forecast accuracy, partner performance, and process bottlenecks.
* Improve scalable operating rhythms: Partner with Professional Services, Customer Success, Finance, Sales, and Partner teams to standardize workflows, close operational gaps, and enable a repeatable delivery model as the business grows.

 **Qualifications** **To be successful in this role you have:**

* Experience applying AI\-enabled tools or automation to improve operating workflows, decision support, reporting, or productivity within a services, operations, or customer\-facing function.
* 3–5 years in Professional Services Operations, Revenue Operations, Partner Operations, PMO operations, or a related SaaS delivery operations role.
* Hands\-on proficiency with PSA, CRM, or project delivery systems; Rocketlane experience is strongly preferred, with Kantata, Certinia/FinancialForce, Salesforce, or comparable platforms also valuable.
* Working knowledge of SaaS Professional Services metrics such as utilization, capacity, backlog, attach rate, forecast accuracy, delivery health, and services margin.
* Background supporting partner\-led or subcontracted delivery models, including intake, onboarding, assignment coordination, operational governance, and process improvement.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to synthesize data from multiple systems, identify trends, and convert findings into practical recommendations for Services leaders.
* Process\-oriented operator who can design lightweight workflows, document repeatable practices, drive adoption, and iterate quickly as the delivery model evolves.
* High ownership and sound judgment in ambiguous, fast\-moving environments; able to make progress independently, escalate thoughtfully, and balance speed with operational discipline.
* Clear communicator and trusted cross\-functional partner who can align Professional Services, Customer Success, Finance, Sales, and Partner stakeholders around priorities, tradeoffs, and execution plans.

 **Additional Information** **Work Personas**


We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third\-party service.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. The Development Pipeline and Business Operation (DPBO) team supports land acquisitions and data center leasing through data integrity oversight, development of standard operating procedures, policies and best practices, and deployment of AI tools aimed at streamlining the agreement flow. DPBO also serves as the connective tissue between DCID and cross\-functional teams, coordinating collaboration and translating priorities. This gives DPBO a birds\-eye view of the entire data center life\-cycle, allowing team members to develop high\-leverage expertise across acquisitions, contracting, technology and business operations.

You will partner closely with leadership and organizational stakeholders to establish standard operating procedures, govern data integrity, and design frictionless approval workflows. Additionally, you will represent DCID across technical, financial, and real estate teams, as you ensure seamless cross\-functional alignment, elevate data\-driven decision\-making, foster continuous organizational learning across the data center delivery lifecycle and ensure strategic priorities are translated into scalable operational frameworks.

**Position Title:**

Large\-Scale Collaboration Grant Project Manager

A. POSITION PURPOSE


Under the supervision of the Sr. Assistant Dean / Chief Operating Officer and in close coordination with project co\-leads, the Project Manager provides administrative, operational, and tactical leadership for the implementation of the $10 Million Lilly Endowment Large\-Scale Collaboration Grant. This 5\-year grant project supports the launch and integration of the Pope Francis Institute for Pastoral Flourishing (PFI), the relocation and integration of JST\-SCU into Santa Clara University’s main campus, and the expansion of regional and national network partnerships.


The Project Manager serves as the primary operational engine driving daily grant activities. This position is responsible for ensuring all strategic deliverables, sub\-project timelines, inter\-departmental workflows, budget tracking, and official compliance reporting to the Lilly Endowment are executed seamlessly, accurately, and on schedule.


B. ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES


1\. Grant Project Management \& Operational Execution


* Serve as the central point of tactical execution, project tracking, and workflow management for all initiatives funded under the $10M Lilly LSC Grant.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive master project plans, timelines, work breakdown structures, and milestone tracking frameworks across all grant components.
* Monitor day\-to\-day progress across project working groups, internal SCU departments (JST, GPPM, Religious Studies), and external collaborating partners.
* Manage the operational roadmap for Year 1 ("Year of Co\-Design"), coordinating inter\-departmental task forces, curriculum alignment teams, and committee deliverables.
* Identify operational bottlenecks, risks, or schedule deviations, implementing corrective action plans to maintain project momentum.

2\. Centralized Compliance, Financial Tracking \& Grant Reporting


* Manage overall compliance with Lilly Endowment Grant Agreement terms, conditions, and reporting requirements.
* Partner closely with SCU Office of Sponsored Projects (SPO), JST Finance, and University Development to monitor the $10M budget, track expenditure allocations, approve line\-item disbursements, and manage sub\-award contracts.
* Coordinate, write, and submit all annual narrative program reports and collaborate with the SPO to submit financial reports to the Lilly Endowment by established deadlines.
* Collect, aggregate, and verify project data, revenue match metrics, and qualitative/quantitative outcomes from constituent units (such as CLTM, PFI, and external partner networks) for centralized reporting.
* Oversee budget revision requests and line\-item reallocations in accordance with Lilly Endowment policy guidelines.

3\. Stakeholder Coordination \& Governance Support


* Facilitate regular communication, meeting schedules, documentation, and reporting streams for the Grant Steering Committee, Advisory Boards, and Working Groups.
* Serve as the primary liaison between internal academic units and external partner organizations (e.g., ACHTUS, RECOSS, Iskali, regional dioceses, Discerning Deacons), managing partner contracts, stipends, and joint project deliverables.
* Maintain central project repositories, shared documentation, communications archives, and collaborative platforms (e.g., Google Workspace/Drive) to ensure transparent governance.

4\. Communications, Dissemination \& Logistics


* Coordinate the execution of project events, national symposia, planning retreats, workshops, and advisory council meetings in collaboration with project staff.
* Implement the grant’s strategic communication and dissemination plan, sharing project insights, best practices, and research outputs with national theological networks and peer institutions.
* Maintain systematic evaluation data and performance indicators to measure long\-term institutional impact and pastoral reach.

5\. Other duties as assigned in support of JST’s mission and operational needs


C. PROVIDES WORK DIRECTION


May at times, directly supervise grant\-funded project personnel, logistics coordinators, and graduate student assistants. Provides cross\-functional project direction and milestone tracking for grant task force leads across partner departments.


D. GENERAL GUIDELINES


Establishes robust project tracking systems and monitors task completion across multiple independent workstreams.


Identifies operational risks early and formulates actionable recommendations for project leads and committee chairs.


Maintains continuous communication with internal SCU administrators, external partners, and grant officers.


Ensures strict adherence to institutional accounting policies, grant agreement terms, and federal/foundation compliance regulations.


Prepares comprehensive progress dashboards and status briefs for executive leadership.


E. QUALIFICATIONS


1\. Knowledge


* Thorough understanding of formal project management methodologies, lifecycle frameworks, and grant administration tools.
* Familiarity with private foundation grant administration (experience with Lilly Endowment grants or higher education sponsored programs highly preferred).
* Understanding of university organizational structures, academic administration, and multi\-institutional collaborative networks.
* Knowledge of Catholic ecclesiology, ministerial formation, and the pastoral realities in the United States preferred.
* Strong understanding of the values, ideals, and mission of Jesuit higher education and the Jesuit School of Theology preferred.
* Knowledge of ATS\-accredited graduate theological education preferred.

* Demons

jobs.description:
Description:

If you're passionate about restoring California's natural landscapes and want to be involved in the entire restoration process from concept through implementation and long\-term success, this is an exciting opportunity to make a lasting impact. As a **Senior Restoration Project Manager**, you'll help lead and grow HELIX's expanding habitat restoration practice in Northern California while working alongside a team that designs, builds, monitors, and maintains restoration projects entirely in\-house.

**Why HELIX?**


At HELIX Environmental Planning, we take pride in delivering innovative environmental solutions that make a meaningful difference. Our team works on diverse public and private sector projects across California, from coastal habitats to mountain ecosystems and the Central Valley. What sets HELIX apart is our ability to handle every stage of habitat restoration under one roof, from planning and permitting to plant propagation, field implementation, and biological monitoring. The **Senior Restoration Project Manager** role offers a unique chance to join a growing Northern California team and help shape the future of our restoration services. We offer a flexible hybrid work schedule with a combination of in\-office and remote work.

**Day in the Life**


As a **Senior Restoration Project Manager**, no two days are the same. You may start your morning collaborating with biologists and restoration practitioners on a large\-scale habitat restoration design, spend the afternoon evaluating a field site, and finish the day helping secure funding for future restoration efforts. The **Senior Restoration Project Manager** works closely with regulatory agencies, field crews, project managers, and clients while helping lead restoration projects from planning through implementation and adaptive management.

**What You'll Do**


As a **Senior Restoration Project Manager**, you will:

* Design and support habitat restoration projects to achieve project goals and success criteria.
* Lead site investigations and restoration feasibility assessments.
* Collaborate with field restoration crews during project implementation and adaptive management.
* Develop habitat restoration plans and support environmental permitting efforts.
* Assist with restoration grant applications and project development.
* Conduct and oversee biological surveys, vegetation mapping, and special\-status species surveys.
* Lead biological monitoring for restoration and construction projects.
* Support wetland permit applications and regulatory documentation.
* Participate in business development, proposal preparation, and project interviews.
* Travel occasionally overnight as project needs require.

**Compensation**


Salary will be based on qualifications and/or experience, with a robust benefits package. Expected starting pay range of **$130,000 to $160,000**.

**Ready to Grow Your Career?**


If you're an experienced **Senior Restoration Project Manager** looking to advance habitat restoration throughout Northern California while helping build and grow a thriving restoration program, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today and join HELIX in creating positive environmental outcomes that last for generations.


HELIX is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and an inclusive work environment. We encourage all qualified applicants to apply regardless of gender, race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), parental status, national origin, disability, age, genetic information (including family medical history), political affiliation, military service, or veteran status. These protections extend to all management practices and decisions, including recruitment and hiring, appraisal systems, promotions, training, and career development programs.


PM21


Requirements:
**Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Biology, Botany, Environmental Science, or a related field.
* 10\+ years of professional experience as a biologist, restoration ecologist, or restoration practitioner.
* At least 2 years of experience working in Northern California.
* Experience with field data collection methods and habitat restoration implementation.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Word and Excel.
* Ability to hike long distances across varied terrain and weather conditions.
* Valid California Driver's License with a clean driving record.
* Ability to travel overnight occasionally.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Environmental consulting experience.
* Society for Ecological Restoration CERP certification.
* ISA Arborist Certification.
* Wetland Delineation or Professional Wetland Scientist certifications.
* Experience coordinating with regulatory agencies.
* ArcGIS field data collection experience.
* Experience with plant propagation, equipment operation, or herbicide application.
* Experience leading biological surveys, monitoring programs, and environmental compliance efforts.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Security Risk Program
jobs.description:
We are building a governance, risk, and compliance function to enable our company to buildproducts that can withstand regulatory scrutiny, and ensure Meta continues to meet globalregulatory requirements and manage risk. Meta's Risk and Compliance Program (RCP) is the central engine driving risk management and compliance at the company, supporting Meta and the family of apps. Within RCP, the Security Risk Program (SRP) is the second\-line function accountable for how Meta identifies, assesses, quantifies, and reports its security risk posture — delivering global security risk assessments, Capability Maturity \& Effectiveness (CME) evaluations, AI and cloud risk assessments, and board\-level and regulatory reporting.We are seeking a Security Risk Program Manager to build one of the program's highest\-priority new capabilities: security risk assessment of AI product launches. Today, AI launches receivead\-hoc coverage through security risk assessments designed for infrastructure — not forproduct\-launch cadence, and not for cross\-domain AI risk spanning Security, Privacy, Integrity,and Legal. You will design that capability from the ground up and scale it from roughly fiveassessments per quarter today to twenty or more per quarter by H1 2027, in step with Meta's AIproduct velocity.This is a builder and an influencer role in equal measure. AI launch risk cannot beassessed by one function acting alone — it requires Central Security, product groups, Privacy,Integrity, and Legal moving through a shared process on a launch timeline. You will own thatoperating model: translating product and engineering reality into a defensible risk position, andtranslating regulatory obligation into assessment work that product teams can actually absorbwithout stalling a launch. The ideal candidate is comfortable with ambiguity, effective inhigh\-pressure and fast\-moving situations, and able to build durable relationships across a widerange of technical and non\-technical stakeholders.  

  

  

### **Program Manager, Security Risk Program Responsibilities:**

* Design and implement Meta's AI Launch Risk Assessment framework end to end — intake criteria, cross\-domain risk taxonomy, assessment methodology, and launch\-gate outputs — and scale delivery from \~5 to 20\+ assessments per quarter by H1 2027\.
* Build and partner to manage the XFN operating model that coordinates Central Security, product groups, Privacy Risk Management, Integrity Risk Management, and Legal through each assessment, with clear roles, handoffs, and decision rights on a launch timeline.
* Partner directly with product and engineering teams on high\-priority AI launches — engaging early enough that security risk review informs design decisions rather than gating release, and giving product teams a predictable, well\-documented path through second\-line review.
* Serve as the connection point between the Security Risk Program, Central Security leadership, Legal, and first\-line business teams, representing security risk positions and negotiating assessment scope, sequencing, and remediation commitments.
* Build and maintain a consolidated AI risk register that gives leadership a single view of.
* security risk across the AI product portfolio, and produce the reporting that keeps that view current for VP and executive audiences.
* Define tooling requirements and drive AI\-enabled automation across the assessment lifecycle — identifying where automation can scale throughput without compromising assessment defensibility, and partnering with tooling and engineering owners to deliver it.
* Ensure assessments and supporting artifacts are produced to internal standards, are.
* submission\-ready, and constitute defensible evidence of systematic security due diligence for regulators and auditors (including EU AI Act and NIST AI RMF expectations).
* Identify risks, dependencies, and blockers across the program, define mitigation plans, monitor key delivery and SLA metrics, and drive corrective action with stakeholders when performance deviates.
* Create and facilitate presentations that build senior leadership understanding and influence decision\-making, and provide mentorship and guidance to junior team members on program design and assessment practice.

  

  

  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 6\+ years of experience in governance, risk, and compliance, security risk management,
* Regulatory compliance, or a directly related discipline
* 2\+ years of program management experience in a corporate environment
* Experience with risk and compliance precepts, practices, and solutions
* Experience designing a program or process from the ground up — not solely running an established one — including methodology, operating model, and rollout
* Experience driving cross\-functional alignment across technical and non\-technical partners without direct authority, including with engineering or product organizations
* Proven verbal and written communication skills, with success influencing a range of audiences including senior leadership

  

  

  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience assessing or managing risk for AI or machine learning systems, or familiarity with AI\-specific regulatory and risk frameworks (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF)
* Experience embedding risk, security, or compliance review into a fast\-moving product

**Join us and make YOUR mark on the World!**


Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) has turned bold ideas into world\-changing impact advancing science and technology to strengthen U.S. security and promote global stability.


Our mission spans four critical national security areas nuclear deterrence, threat preparedness, energy security, and multi\-domain defense empowering teams to take on the toughest challenges of today and tomorrow. With a culture built on innovation and operational excellence, LLNL is a place where your expertise can make a real impact.

We have multiple openings for **Project Managers** to lead project\-management activities and support the planning and successful execution of high\-impact technical projects addressing critical national security challenges. You will serve as a key project\-management resource for milestone\-driven research and development efforts in a fast\-paced, multidisciplinary environment. Working closely with Associate Program Leaders, Principal Investigators, technical staff, and other project stakeholders, you will help organize project teams and coordinate schedules, budgets, milestones, risks, resources, agreements, reporting, and technical communications to enable successful project execution on aggressive timelines.


You will contribute to a growing portfolio of national security research and development initiatives in areas such as cyber\-physical systems assurance, national security infrastructure, supply chain security, and disaster resilience. This position provides an opportunity to apply project\-management, technical, and operational expertise to first\-of\-a\-kind national security work while helping technical teams effectively organize, plan, coordinate, and execute complex activities. This position is in the National Security Engineering Division within the Engineering Directorate.


*Depending on your assignment, this position may offer a hybrid work arrangement, blending in\-person and virtual presence. You may have the flexibility to work from home one or more days per week.*


These positions will be filled at either level based on knowledge and related experience as assessed by the hiring team. Additional job responsibilities (outlined below) will be assigned if hired at the higher level.


**In this role, you will**


* Lead day\-to\-day project\-management activities for milestone\-driven technical projects across cyber and infrastructure domains, including schedules, deliverables, dependencies, resources, budgets, risks, and project documentation.
* Advise and support Associate Program Leaders and Principal Investigators in project team organization, resource coordination, budget tracking, scheduling, milestone planning, risk mitigation, and progress toward technical and programmatic objectives.
* Gather, analyze, and synthesize scientific and technical information for project reports, proposals, milestone deliverables, sponsor communications, and decision briefings.
* Coordinate technical and operational communications among project teams, collaborators, management, sponsors, and other stakeholders to support timely and effective project execution.
* Identify and recommend improvements to established project\-management and operational principles, methods, and tools to improve project execution, workflow, documentation, team coordination, and organizational processes.

* Coordinate with staff and project\-management personnel at other national laboratories and partner organizations to support communication, planning, team organization, resource coordination, milestones, and execution of multi\-laboratory projects and consortia.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Additional job responsibilities, at the TSS.3 level**

* Perform independent technical and operational analyses, synthesize project information, and develop recommendations to inform strategic project decisions involving schedules, budgets, resources, risks, priorities, and execution approaches.
* Analyze and resolve complex project execution issues requiring in\-depth analysis, ingenuity, and creative application of established project\-management, technical, and operational methods.
* Coordinate and prioritize multiple parallel activities involving competing requirements, changing priorities, or less well\-defined assignments, and provide project leadership for defined activities by coordinating contributors and guiding execution toward project objectives.

* Comprehensive knowledge of project\-management concepts, practices, and tools, with broad experience applying project\-management principles, theories, concepts, and techniques to technical or operational projects.
* Comprehensive experience independent

About the Role \| Why It's Exciting  


As a Clinician and Intensive Care Coordinator (ICC), you will provide evidence\-based therapy and coordinate comprehensive care for youth, caregivers, schools, and community providers. You will develop collaborative care plans that reflect each family's voice, strengthen relationships, and connect youth and families with the support they need. In this role, you will deliver high\-impact, community\-based behavioral health services in Contra Costa County for a respected nonprofit with more than 60 years of service to youth and families. Our collaborative, strengths\-based culture values your expertise, honors your lived experience, and actively supports your professional growth.  


What You Bring  


You're a compassionate clinician committed to trauma\-informed, culturally responsive, and family\-centered care. You bring clinical judgment, organizational excellence, and the ability to manage complex cases. We serve clients with broad and complex needs, so would prefer candidates with experience in one or more of the following areas:  


Complex trauma and attachment\-related challenges  


Autism Spectrum Disorder and neurodevelopmental conditions  


LGBTQ\+ affirming care and gender\-affirming practice  


Co\-occurring behavioral and physical health conditions  


Working with historically marginalized communities and addressing behavioral health disparities  


Bilingual English/Spanish skills are a plus and will be taken into consideration when factoring the overall compensation package, yet we welcome applications from all qualified candidates.

Help Youth and Families Thrive  


Provide strengths\-based, trauma\-informed, and culturally responsive mental health care through comprehensive assessment, treatment planning, and individual and family therapy. Support youth and caregivers in building resilience, developing effective coping skills, strengthening family connections, and achieving meaningful treatment goals. Lead Collaborative Care Coordination  


Facilitate Child and Family Team (CFT) meetings and case conferences with caregivers, service providers, and educators. Guide collaborative decision\-making, ensure every voice is heard, and align treatment plans with each family's strengths and goals.  


Drive Lasting Outcomes  


Coordinate services among schools, behavioral health providers, child welfare agencies, and community partners to ensure that youth and families receive connected, culturally responsive, and trauma\-informed support.  


Maintain Quality Documentation

Individual and group clinical supervision at no cost (clinical hours count toward BBS Licensure)  


Dedicated professional development for licensed providers pursuing Clinical Director or supervisor roles

Mileage reimbursement

Bilingual differential: $3,000 or more annually. Clear career pathways exist for clinicians interested in supervision, program development, or leadership roles.  


Required Qualifications  


Master's degree in social work, Counseling, Psychology, Marriage and Family Therapy, or a related field

Commitment to trauma\-informed, culturally responsive, and family\-centered care and strong clinical judgment, organizational skills, and ability to manage complex cases

At least 21 years of age

**About Anthropic**
-------------------



Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------



Anthropic's Integrity \& Compliance function is building the systems that let us scale responsibly as our products reach more people, more enterprises, and more governments. Corporate Compliance is a key pillar of that function, covering anti\-bribery and anti\-corruption, conflicts of interest, gifts and hospitality, outside activities, the Code of Conduct, and related employee\-conduct matters.



As Senior Compliance Program Manager, you will build and run Anthropic's political law compliance program — the operating infrastructure behind our corporate PAC, corporate political giving, state and local pay\-to\-play preclearance, and the gift and ethics rules governing our interactions with public officials. Because we run lean, you may support certain workstreams in our broader corporate compliance program — gifts and hospitality, conflicts of interest, outside business activities and related day\-to\-day matters — and help design the AI\-assisted workflows that let a small team cover a large surface area.



This is a builder's role. * Build and deliver training, quick\-reference guidance and intake how\-tos for Policy, GTM and leadership; keep policies and procedures current as the footprint changes
* Serve as product owner for AI\-assisted intake, screening and case\-management workflows in your areas — define requirements, run testing, decide what is automated versus human\-reviewed, and report program metrics to leadership
* Spot legal questions early and route them to Policy Legal or outside counsel with the facts assembled; keep I\&C, Legal and outside counsel calibrated on risk

* Track record building a program, not just operating one — designing preclearance or disclosure workflows, registers, filing calendars and controls from scratch or through a major redesign

* 7\+ years of experience in compliance program management
* Experience in a corporate government affairs compliance function, a political law practice or compliance vendor, or a financ

We're a high\-growth fintech company changing the retirement industry. We are backed by a number of investors. This includes funding from Marshall Wace and Baillie Gifford, as well as top investors such as BlackRock, TPG (The Rise Fund), SoftBank, Glynn Capital, NewView Capital, USVP, Wing, Uncork, and more.


**About the role**



Analytics are central to our success. Analytics are at the heart of how we make decisions as a company. We're building the first full stack, automated retirement management platform in the industry – and data tells us how to optimize. We are a fast growing company, and it's time to build an enterprise grade data stack. You will be responsible for using data to identify process vulnerabilities and general optimization opportunities. The ability to take large data sets and transform them into actionable business recommendations will be paramount to success in this role.


**What you get to do every day**


* Be part of a dynamic and growing team that will help you level up your skills
* Build and maintain data sets, models and visualizations
* Build and maintain dashboards and reports in Hex, Salesforce and Google Sheet.

* Work with business partners to identify key metrics, how to improve them, and establish perpetual tracking methods
* Work with engineers and product managers to set data tracking requirements
* Provide guidance, reports, and dashboards to successfully track and move these metrics
* Proactively present insights to help our customers and business based on a deep understanding of operations
* Deep dives on a wide range of processes in order to identify the biggest opportunities for optimization
* Be creative and explore data for impactful business insights


**What you bring to the role**


* Minimum 5\+ years of experience working in analytics or data science
* Ability to present stakeholders with clear, accurate, and impactful recommendations based on data
* Expertise with developing and maintaining compelling data visualizations
* Ability to connect the dots between data and business impact
* Experience building dashboards and reports in Hex, including using Hex's AI capabilities
* Experience building dashboards and reports in Salesforce
* Experience building dashboards and reports in Gsheet or Excel.
* Experience with Salesforce process and flow development
* Proactive and professional communication in all settings
* Comfortable working with and combining data across many different data sources
* Passion for learning and growing analytical and process improvement skillset
* Flexibility in being able to quickly pivot between tasks when necessary
* Experience with database design and administration a plus
* Experience with SQL a plus
* Experience with Lean and/or Six Sigma methodology a plus

Human Interest is tackling one of our country's biggest challenges \- closing the retirement gap. You'll be instrumental in architecting and scaling solutions that bring financial security to employees at small and medium\-sized businesses nationwide. We've made significant progress, but there is still growth ahead, offering you a unique opportunity to solve complex problems, drive innovation, and advance your career alongside a dedicated, mission\-driven team. We value hard work and recognize that our team's contributions are key to our continued success.

Documenting this core aspect of our culture helps employees make good decisions on their own. It also helps candidates considering career opportunities critically evaluate whether they will thrive at Human Interest.

* **Autonomous and Accountable Teams**: We trust our team members to take ownership and make smart decisions. We empower you to be your best self!
* **An Escalating Bar for Talent and Performance**: We're constantly raising the bar and challenging ourselves to be better. We believe in growth and continuous improvement.
* **Fundamental Optimism**: We see the glass as half full (and then we fill it up with more amazing ideas!). We believe in the power of positivity and the potential for greatness.

jobs.title: Subscription Services Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3\.7 billion in revenue, its first billion\-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27\. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology \- hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.



This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

**ABOUT THIS ROLE…**



The Renewal Operations Specialist is a key individual contributor on the Renewal team that consistently delivers market leading retention rates and more. The Renewal team is a culmination of individuals who are passionate about customer loyalty committed to bringing the right people together with the intention of securing and growing our revenue.



This role will be focused on ensuring the new deals that build from the installed base are being quoted accurately with the intent to align expiration dates and streamline the renewal process; inclusive of what was originally purchased to align with Finance expectations. This individual will assist the Renewal team review, revise, report, and upgrade opportunities that impact the installed base and build algorithms with our Business Intelligence Team. The importance of building SOX compliance processes and a solid reporting structure to our business is a key initiative as we look to the future and you would be integral in making this happen.



Your ability to drive business process, manage heavy transaction workloads with a keen attention to detail will enable the team to secure more revenue prior to the maintenance expiration date, ultimately removing the risk of reducing the contract value. Focusing on accuracy upfront will allow for predictability as we look to secure the renewals.


**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**


* Provide operational and administrative/backend support to assigned SSR(s) to enable seamless execution of the renewals process.
* Enable pipeline readiness with the understanding of Account Mapping and Territory Alignment
* Triage and route inquiries from a high\-volume renewal inbox to the appropriate functional owner
* Goal is to operationalize the Subscription Services Representatives pipeline while optimize renewal rate, attach rate and term
* Be a point of contact with Channel Partners \& Account Managers to proactively market subscription opportunities to partners and/or resolve issues that may hinder them from maintaining a relationship with Pure Storage
* Effectively communicate company messages, value propositions, etc. verbally and in writing
* Accountable for reviewing and validating subscription renewals against customer installed base reports and additional sources of data
* Ability to research original business transactions and prepare detail that will lead the account team to make quick recommendations on how to position the following subscription cycle
* Accurately confirm and quote all subscription renewal opportunities for assigned territory
* Develop and communicate process change and improvements to optimize programs and enhance relationships with necessary company external customers and internal support groups
* Track all activity in Salesforce, Stage 1 to Stage 2 FisF or other PERC Ticket Closures to move Renewal Opportunities Stage 3
* Accountable for reviewing and checking accuracy with upgrades executed by the field and Inside Account teams
* Work closely with Renewal, Sales and Finance teams to get upgrades to co\-term to existing renewal dates
* Responsible for assisting the team with verifying pricing and data to ensure accuracy in Pure internal tools
* Fulfills installed base requests for field
* Accountable for data related projects that help improve the Renewal reporting


**WHAT YOU'LL BRING:**


* 2\+ years experience in sales operations and or contract administration
* Solid Salesforce aptitude
* Ability to organize and prioritize activities
* Strong oral and written communication skills
* Organizational and follow up skills, problem solving and analytical skills
* Inventory/installed base management experience is a plus
* Ability to take initiative, work flexibly, and adhere to priorities with minimal direct supervision.


\#LI\-ONSITE

* **Innovation**: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.
* **Growth**: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology™, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!
* **Team**: We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good.


And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company\-sponsored team events. Check out http://benefits.everpuredata.com/ for more information.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Position Overview**
---------------------



Fujifilm’s Data Storage Solutions division provides magnetic storage tape to customers around the world, supporting mission critical data retention needs across a wide range of industries. Magnetic tape is recognized as a core component of modern data center infrastructure, valued for its reliability, cost efficiency, and low power consumption in large scale and long\-term data archival.


As AI workloads drive data volumes to grow at an unprecedented pace, demand for Fujifilm’s magnetic tape is expanding rapidly. To further accelerate this growth and strengthen our engagement with key hyperscale customers, we are adding an experienced Account Manager to our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for maximizing revenue, building and maintaining long term relationships, and serving as a primary point of contact for purchasing, supply chain, engineering, and related functions within major hyperscale accounts.


**This position is remote and based on the West Coast.**


**Company Overview**
--------------------


"
At FUJIFILM North America Corporation, we are many things to both consumers and business customers. We’re looking for passionate, mission\-driven people to help us continue to innovate.

  

  

With five operating divisions, there’s a lot of opportunity to find your niche and make an impact. Perhaps you’ll click with our Imaging Division that provides one\-time\-use cameras, digital printing equipment, and instax™. Maybe you’ll get charged up about our Electronic Imaging Division that markets digital cameras, lenses, and accessories for content creators. Or, you might have your eye on our Optical Devices Division, which provides optical lenses for the broadcast, cinematography, videography, and industrial markets. You could be drawn to our Business Innovation Division—they develop office and commercial print solutions and enable digital transformation. And if you’re interested in tape, check out our Industrial Products Division—they develop data storage solutions.  



  

We offer a collegial culture and a flexible work environment. Our headquarters is in Valhalla, New York, a quaint town just one hour north of New York City.  



  

Fujifilm is globally headquartered in Tokyo with over 70,000 employees across four key business segments of healthcare, electronics, business innovation, and imaging. We are guided and united by our Group Purpose of “giving our world more smiles.” Visit: https://www.fujifilm.com/us/en/about/region/careers


"
**Job Description**
-------------------



**Responsibilities**

  

* Manage and deepen relationships with existing hyperscale customers, ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction and trust.
* Identify and pursue new business opportunities within key accounts, leading end‑to‑end proposal and leveraging the growing demand for tape‑based storage.
* Develop and implement account strategies to achieve revenue targets and increase FUJIFILM’s share of business within each account.
* Engage with multiple stakeholders at customer organizations (e.g., purchasing, engineering, SCM) and maintain strong relationships at various organizational levels.
* Strengthen relationships with system integration partners and establish a seamless co\-operation for hyperscale customers
* Collaborate closely with internal technical, supply chain, and operations support teams, as well as Tokyo headquarters, to align sales activities and to ensure effective coordination between customer requests and internal operations
* Prepare and maintain accurate sales forecasts and provide input to internal stakeholders to support production scheduling and inventory planning.
* Review and negotiate contracts, commercial terms, and conditions in cooperation with internal stakeholders, including legal, finance, and operations.
* Monitor market trends in storage, data centers, and hyperscale ecosystems, and provide structured feedback to internal teams to support product and business planning.

**Required Skills/Education**

  

* Minimum of 10 years of account management experience, preferably in the IT industry.
* Demonstrated experience in managing large‑scale, strategic enterprise customers.
* Experience in selling IT‑related products (software and/or hardware).
* Strong relationship‑building, negotiation, and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Ability to work independently in a dynamic environment and to collaborate effectively with cross‑functional and cross‑cultural teams.

**Desired Skills**

  

* Knowledge of storage, cloud, or data center industries.
* Direct sales or account management experience with hyperscale customers (e.g., AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform, or other large‑scale cloud service providers).
* Experience in selling storage hardware such as SSDs and HDDs, and/or other data‑center‑grade storage systems.
* Experience working in a global organization and coordinating with overseas headquarters (e.g., Tokyo).
* Willingness to travel to customer sites approximately once per month within North America.
* Occasional international travel to Japan to accompany key customers and to coordinate with Tokyo headquarters

**Salary and Benefits**  

* Salary: $120,000 plus bonus depending on experience.
* Medical, Dental, Vision
* Life Insurance
* 401k
* Paid Time Off

jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About us**
------------


MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

  

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

  

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

  

We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

  

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera.

  

**The job**
-----------


You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

  

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

  

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

  

You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

  

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

  

**Nice to have:**
-----------------

* AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

  

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

 *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*
